name: squ1ggs-boosting-tools-app
description: Desktop control panel for Squ1ggs Boosting Tools (Borderlands 4 SDK mod).
author: RDPSqu1ggs

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check lib/bridge.js && node --check lib/status.js && node --check lib/game_paths.js && node --check lib/sdkmod_install.js && node --check lib/oak2_sdk.js && node --check lib/app_settings.js && node --check lib/list_favorites.js && node --check lib/serial_sources.js && node --check lib/bl4_save_bay.js && node --check lib/serial_codec.js && node --check lib/item_analysis.js && node --check lib/image_item_match.js && node --check lib/update_check.js && node --check lib/github_update.js && node --check renderer/i18n.js && node --check renderer/app.js && node --check renderer/editor/js/sqbt_editor_bridge.js
scripts.prepack: npm run sync:sdkmod && npm run check && npm run smoke:black-market && npm run smoke:map-reveal && npm run smoke:manifest && npm run smoke:give-progress && npm run smoke:workflow-ui && npm run smoke:card-assets && npm run smoke:card-regressions && npm run smoke:card-gold && npm run smoke:card-rarity && npm run smoke:item-workflow && npm run smoke:image-builder && npm run smoke:picture-card && npm run smoke:curated-builds && npm run smoke:release && python tools/clean_release_runtime_artifacts.py
scripts.pack: electron-builder --dir --publish never && npm run smoke:card-assets:packed && npm run check:native && npm run smoke:release:packed
scripts.dist:portable: npm run pack && npm run pack:zip
scripts.dist:win: npm run smoke:card-assets && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never && npm run smoke:card-assets:packed
scripts.smoke:release: node tools/native_release_boundary.js && node tools/setup_runtime_check.js && node tools/setup_auto_install_check.js
scripts.check:native: node tools/native_release_boundary.js && python tools/native_runtime_check.py && python tools/startup_runtime_check.py
